purpose: Exploratory parser selection. Final qualification uses the separate five paired 78-scan validation; these short probes are not goal completion.
reference: c8e6cd8 streaming scanner; statx interface unchanged for all these parser probes.
contract_checks: Both size-mode mappings, descending output order, successful exits, and no incomplete-total warnings were checked on the unchanged default fixture. The source passed raw-name, name-terminator, record-boundary, sparse-file, symlink, hardlink, root-file-exclusion, large-directory and deep-descent tests.

probe_descriptions.vector-names-trial: Use bounded SSE2 loads on x86-64 to locate the first NUL and reject earlier path separators. Scalar handling covers short tails and other architectures. Reuse the existing file_size inline trial.
probe_descriptions.size-mode-trial: Dispatch size mode once at scan entry and root-only filtering once at enumeration entry. Const parameters specialize the recursive and iterative walks, masks and size fields. Reuse the validated CStr directly for narrow metadata calls.
probe_descriptions.batch-mode-trial: Dispatch serial versus parallel metadata once per initialized getdents64 batch, separating the batch parser from directory reads.
probe_descriptions.record-slice-trial: Make one checked record slice and index header fields relative to that bounded slice.
probe_descriptions.single-mask-trial: Combine the NUL and slash comparison masks, then inspect the first special byte. This retains exact terminator and padding behavior with fewer scalar operations.

interpretation: Bounded vector validation removes roughly a third of user instructions versus the inlined streaming scanner. Constant mode dispatch and a combined vector mask reduce allocated-mode instructions below 200 million/scan in short probes. These changes do not establish lower total CPU or elapsed time. Keep syscall counts, memory and accounting validation separate.
